capability.summary: Explicit user request: move existing song exports to Documents/songs and save future JSON exports there, with other sequencer exports in Documents. User confirmed only on Export, not autosave. Product work overrides default GA-only scope and extends the still-open export PR #51 with the related destination behavior.

controls.description: Only explicit exports write song JSON to Documents/songs and WAV/MP3/ZIP to Documents; preserve older files and report actual saved paths.
controls.test: Real disk files from every GUI export, no file from editing/autosave, embedded samples, Unicode filenames, static-host fallback, cancellation and retry.

controls.description: Loopback same-origin export API accepts only fixed file categories and publishes complete files without replacing existing ones.
controls.test: Concurrent same-name saves, traversal and origin/host rejection, size limits, symlink escape, permission denial and disconnected upload cleanup.

fixtures: Temporary Documents directories with actual Node filesystem writes
Chrome GUI with generated WAV sample bytes
Dev and preview server export middleware
